spec.title: Add Two Numbers
taskFacts: Two nonempty linked lists encode nonnegative integers, one decimal digit per node, with least significant digit first.
Return a linked list in the same reverse-digit order representing their sum. Input numbers have no leading zero except zero itself. Lists may differ in length and a final carry may add a node.
constraints: Input numbers do not have leading zeros, except the number zero.

examples.explanation: The encoded inputs are 81 and 9; their sum is 90.
The carry creates another digit node.
